blocks.text:
Day 14 · City tour Sugar Loaf & Corcovado (6 hours). After breakfast, your guide takes you to Praia Vermelha (Red Beach) to board the cable car to Urca Hill, then on to Sugar Loaf Mountain (Pão de Açúcar), where the panorama of the city between mountains and sea stretches towards Copacabana Beach.

After descending, visit the historic part of Rio before heading to the foot of Corcovado, where a train winds through the tropical rainforest. A short walk from the final station leads to the statue of Christ the Redeemer and its spectacular panoramic views. Return to the hotel with your guide.

After the tour, transfer to Búzios, around 2 hours from Rio. The journey passes through tropical scenery. On arrival, transfer to your hotel on the coast.
